collection.title: Peugeot 207 SW 2007 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 207 SW 2007 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this 207, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
